verdict.rationale: Mistral states it provides official SDK clients in both Python and TypeScript, which covers the two named languages. However, nothing in the pack shows those SDKs are typed, cover the OCR/annotation and batch (/v1/batch) endpoints, or ship sensible defaults. Missing for 10: evidence of typed models, explicit SDK coverage of OCR/parse, annotations/extract and batch jobs, documented defaults, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK developer experience.
